$comment: Home story wolf: a three-frame push-in (assets/wolf/frames/wolf-1..3.png), each frame closer than the last. Anchors are the midpoint between the eyes, as fractions of width/height from the top-left. 'scale' is how much closer a frame is than the previous one, measured from eye spacing and eye-to-nose distance. After changing frames or numbers, run `npm run prepare:wolf`. Read by scripts/prepare-wolf.mjs and the Home story.
alt: A white wolf stepping out of a mountain cave toward the viewer, its eyes catching cobalt light

grade.$comment: Gradient map from luminance to the brand palette. Stops are [luminance 0..1, hex]. Shadows are crushed first so the scene reads as night; above 'shoulder' highlights roll off smoothly instead of clipping, so white fur keeps its texture. 'stillExposure' is the exposure baked into the graded stills (the live story animates its own).
